name: Web Research
description: Using the web_search and web_fetch tools to research documentation, current facts, and external resources.
instructions: When you need information outside the workspace (docs, current events, APIs, libraries), use web_search to find results, then web_fetch to read the full content of the most relevant result. Prefer official documentation and primary sources. If a search returns no results, try rephrasing the query with more specific terms. Always verify facts from at least one fetched page rather than relying on search snippets alone.
examples: To learn the latest FastAPI API, web_search 'fastapi documentation', then web_fetch the official docs URL.
To check if a library exists, web_search '<library> python package', then web_fetch its PyPI page.
constraints: Never fetch URLs that are not http/https.
Respect the max_chars limit to avoid huge responses.
